youtube_description: What happens when listeners stop tuning the dial and start binge‑downloading? This timeline shows two decades of ad dollars: traditional US broadcast radio (AM/FM) largely flat or shrinking, versus podcast advertising exploding from near‑zero to multi‑billion dollars. Sources: IAB/PwC podcast ad reports, industry bodies (NAB, BIA/Statista) for radio. Watch until the end for the moment podcasting flips from niche to mainstream—and how advertisers quietly followed the audiences. Like, subscribe, and comment which podcast you think turned the industry. Want a dataset for your own chart race video?
